PitchBook Benchmarks for PE, VC, and
more 
PitchBook Benchmarks provide a detailed
snapshot of the latest data for closed-end fund
returns across strategies. The new edition is
now available, updated through Q3 2024 with
preliminary quarterly returns through Q4. It
features tables and charts that break down the
data by geography and fund type. Additional
data and vintage years are available in Excel
data packs for PitchBook clients.
